name: Hive 1.15.0
notes: Run coding agents fully offline on local models: Custom and Ollama runtimes get a real agent tool loop with built-in file tools and MCP, each turn's edits isolated in a worktree for review, cache-friendly compaction, model-family profiles, Vault retrieval and a Quick tasks model. HTTP MCP servers accept static bearer tokens stored on-device. New `hive serve` home-host mode (HTTP + SSE API, worker, push notifications) with an experimental self-built iOS client. Note: saved MCP OAuth connections need reconnecting once.
